title: Cell Co-culture Patterning Using Aqueous Two-phase Systems
protocol: Prepare solutions containing PEG and DEX in the desired buffer or cell culture medium.
Record the mass of PEG and DEX in each solution.
Vortex serum-free solutions to dissolve polymers.
Rock media-containing protein or serum solutions until fully dissolved.
Note the initial concentrations of the media used for dissolution.
Wait for polymer solutions to appear cloudy, indicating potential phase separation.
Allow cloudy solutions to rest vertically at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge samples at 1,000 x g to accelerate phase separation.
Observe the formation of a DEX-rich bottom phase and PEG-rich top phase.
Slowly add additional buffer or media in small increments.
Continue adding until solution becomes clear post-centrifugation.
Record the final weight of the tube.
Determine the % wt/wt of each polymer at which phase separation no longer occurs using recorded and final weights.
Plot these values as % wt/wt PEG on the y-axis and % wt/wt DEX on the x-axis to create a binodal curve.
Prepare separate solutions of 5.0% wt/wt PEG in cell culture medium.
Prepare separate solutions of 12.8% wt/wt DEX in cell culture medium.
Ensure that ATPS solutions are at least twice the critical point concentration.
Transfer the cell culture dish to a humidity- and temperature-controlled incubator for further processing.
Harvest the cells for exclusion patterning.
Determine the total number and concentration of harvested cells.
Label cells with CellTracker or other non-cytotoxic labels for fluorescence microscopy (optional).
Pellet the cells and resuspend in 5.0% PEG to achieve desired cell number, e.g., 37,500 fibroblast cells in 200 μl for a well of a 96-well plate.
Dispense 0.5 μl droplets of DEX onto a dry cell culture substrate using a micropipettor.
Deposit DEX droplets 24 hours ahead and allow to dehydrate at room temperature (optional).
Dispense 200 μl of PEG cell suspension over the DEX droplets.
Incubate for 12 hours at 37 °C, 5% CO2 in a humidified incubator without tilting the dish.
Remove the PEG solution and wash three times with 200 μl culture medium.
Add fresh culture medium to the well.
Return the cultures to the incubator and monitor periodically for cell movement into exclusion zones.
Prepare solutions of 5.0% wt/wt PEG in cell culture medium.
Prepare solutions of 12.8% wt/wt DEX in cell culture medium.
Harvest cells for island patterning.
Determine total number and concentration of harvested cells.
Pellet the cells.
Resuspend the cells in an appropriate volume of 12.8% DEX to achieve a desired concentration, up to 5,000 cells/μl or less for strongly adherent cell types.
Pipette 0.5 μl droplets of DEX onto a dry cell culture substrate without allowing them to dry.
Optional: Add 200 μl of PEG solution to the well ahead of time.
Deposit DEX droplets into the PEG solution and allow them to sink to the bottom and contact the culture surface for cleaner island patterns.
Cover DEX droplets with 200 μl of PEG.
Place in a humidified incubator for 12 hr at 37 °C, 5% CO2 without tilting the dish.
Remove PEG solution from the well.
Wash three times with 200 μl of culture medium.
Add fresh culture medium to the well and return to the incubator.
Monitor cultures periodically to observe cell movement and proliferation outwards from islands.
Prepare solutions of 5.0% wt/wt PEG in cell culture medium.
Prepare solutions of 12.8% wt/wt DEX in cell culture medium.
Harvest the cells to be used for exclusion and island patterning.
Determine the total number/concentration of cells available for each cell type.
Optionally, treat the cells used for exclusion with mitomycin C for 2 hr or irradiate them before harvesting.
Pellet the cells intended for exclusion patterning.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate volume of 5.0% PEG to achieve the desired number of cells.
Pellet the cells intended for island patterning.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate volume of 12.8% DEX to achieve the desired concentration of cells.
Dispense 0.5 μl droplets of DEX cell suspension onto a dry cell culture substrate using a micropipettor.
Cover the DEX droplets with 200 μl of PEG cell suspension.
Place in a humidified incubator for 12 hr at 37 °C, 5% CO2 without tilting the dish or shelf.
Remove the PEG solution after 12 hours.
Wash three times in 200 μl of culture medium.
Add fresh culture medium and return to the incubator.
Monitor the co-cultures to observe interaction between cell populations.
